modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight's seat map because seat categories vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Reserved-seat options are Standard, Front and Extra-legroom seats. Categories and positions vary by aircraft; the booking seat map shows the options for your flight.

reserved_or_random.value: Pay to reserve a particular seat, or receive a free random seat when checking in between 24 and two hours before departure. Reserved-seat prices depend on location.

family_seating.value: Children aged 2 to 11 must sit beside an accompanying adult. With free random allocation, Ryanair seats children beside an adult on the same booking; other adults and teenagers may sit separately.

change_seat.value: Use My Booking and choose change seats to update a reserved seat, including after check-in.

modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Distinguish the included under-seat bag from the larger, paid cabin-bag option.

personal_item.value: All fares include one under-seat bag, maximum 40 x 30 x 20 cm.

priority_cabin_bag.value: Priority & 2 Cabin Bags adds an overhead bag up to 10 kg and 55 x 40 x 20 cm.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Choose the bag allowance when booking; Basic does not include a checked bag.

checked_bag_options.value: Paid checked-bag options include 10 kg, 20 kg and 23 kg.

purchase_limits.value: Up to three 20 kg bags or one 23 kg bag can be purchased per passenger.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: Basic suits travellers taking only a small bag. Compare the total price after adding the extras you need.

basic_fare.value: Basic includes one small under-seat bag and a randomly allocated seat at check-in; no additional baggage is included.

regular_fare.value: Regular adds a standard seat, priority boarding and a second cabin bag up to 10 kg.

plus_fare.value: Plus includes a standard seat, a small cabin bag and a 20 kg checked bag.

voluntary_refunds.value: Tickets are generally non-refundable if the flight operates and you choose not to travel.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Check My Bookings and the disruption message before buying replacement travel.

cancelled_flight_options.value: For a cancelled flight, request a refund, rerouting subject to availability, or a free change to another date on the same route.

long_delay_refund.value: For a delay of at least five hours, passengers who decide not to travel can request a refund.

care_and_compensation.value: Care and compensation depend on the disruption and applicable passenger-rights rules. Extraordinary circumstances can exclude compensation. Contact Ryanair before arranging alternative transport and keep receipts.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Online check-in and bag drop have different deadlines. Allow time for security after dropping bags.

online_checkin.value: Without a reserved seat, online check-in opens 24 hours before departure and closes two hours before.

reserved_seat_checkin.value: A pre-reserved seat allows online check-in up to 60 days ahead; both outbound and return flights must fall within that window.

airport_bag_drop.value: Check-in and bag-drop desks open no later than two hours before departure and close strictly 40 minutes before, unless Ryanair advises otherwise.

airport_checkin_fee.value: Airport check-in normally incurs a fee. Complete online check-in before its deadline.

modules.title: Contact and the small print
modules.lede: Use the official contact page to choose your country's support options.
